purpose: 同原发布时间/精确附件事件绑定的有限登记及一次取得，不改变原量与现有源码
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import hashlib,json,subprocess,requests
root=Path.cwd()
parent=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_prior_use_source_v1"
out=root/"reports/research/510300_2018q3_loan_allocation_release_pdf_binding_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("原产物已存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout
proposal_path=parent/"next_experiment.json"
assert sha(proposal_path.read_bytes())=="e73eb081c828eb1d7cd5c1a25f43a6382a655ebe41a84aae3dae1b845d0667bf"
proposal=read(proposal_path)
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E115" and proposal["status"]=="PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN"
pdf=root/proposal["fixed_original_identity"]["saved_pdf_path"]
assert sha(pdf.read_bytes())==proposal["fixed_original_identity"]["saved_pdf_sha256"]
terms=["2018101915120016594.pdf","2025092212545489133","2018年三季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告"]
checked=[]
old=root/"reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1"
for p in sorted(old.glob("*执行记录.json")):
    t=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    checked.append({"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes()),"exact_identity_terms_present":[s for s in terms if s in t]})
assert len(checked)==8 and not any(x["exact_identity_terms_present"] for x in checked)
for name in ["2018Q3_唯一新首次GET回执_E114.json","三固定原季度全部定位选择_E114.json"]:
    p=parent/name
    checked.append({"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes()),"role":"仅原响应/定位，非已存发布页自己的附件与公开头绑定"})
save("有限本地同原发布记录核对_E115.json",{"at":now(),"finite_records":checked,"exact_existing_release_pdf_publication_binding":False,
     "scope":"只同原直接旧记录和八项旧官方目录执行记录；不搜索全部仓库或按其他季度钟补齐"})
status=git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no")
save("运行前git记录_E115.json",{"at":now(),"branch":git("branch","--show-current").strip(),"HEAD":git("rev-parse","HEAD").strip(),"tracked_status":status})
protocol={
 "experiment_id":"E115","study_id":"510300_2018Q3_LOAN_ALLOCATION_RELEASE_PDF_BINDING_V1","registered_at":now(),
 "status":"REGISTERED_SAME_ORIGINAL_RELEASE_TIME_AND_ATTACHMENT_IDENTITY_BEFORE_ONE_GET",
 "question":proposal["question"],"parent_proposal":{"path":rel(proposal_path),"sha256":sha(proposal_path.read_bytes())},
 "parent_result":{"path":rel(parent/"result.json"),"sha256":sha((parent/"result.json").read_bytes())},
 "fixed_original_identity":proposal["fixed_original_identity"],
 "fixed_candidate_release_page":proposal["candidate_release_page"],
 "binding_rule":proposal["binding_rule"],"own_clock_rule":"原页明确PubDate/原公开头日期；仅日期取该日末，公开上界不迟于原截止。标题和精确已存PDF解析后绝对href必须同时对应。创建/修改/取得/URL/HTTP日期/Last-Modified均不得补钟。",
 "source_rule":"只此同原事件的新时间/附件证据；禁止重取已存PDF、追加查询、重试、跟随跳转、另用载体或其他季度。",
 "local_record_review":{"path":rel(out/"有限本地同原发布记录核对_E115.json"),"sha256":sha((out/"有限本地同原发布记录核对_E115.json").read_bytes())},
 "request_budget":proposal["new_request_budget_if_no_existing_exact_binding"],
 "network_settings":{"connect_timeout_seconds":12,"read_timeout_seconds":30,"TLS_verify":True,"allow_redirects":False},
 "financial_budget":proposal["financial_budget"],"financial_admission":proposal["financial_admission"],
 "E114_original_three_responses_values_own_clocks_and_failure_preserved":True,
 "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,
 "all_original79_1711_1212_financial_source_support":"NOT_COMPUTED_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "new_financial_information_admitted":False,"current_fixed79_stock_labels_read":False,
 "DR007_no_valid_access_preserved":True,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,
 "prospective_forecasts":False,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False
}
save("protocol.json",protocol)
url=proposal["candidate_release_page"]["url"]
save("唯一发布页首次GET认领_E115.json",{"at":now(),"url":url,"url_status_before_GET":"INFERRED_SAME_ORIGINAL_RELEASE_PARENT_NOT_VERIFIED",
     "protocol_sha256":sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes()),"attempt":1,"retry":0,"redirect_following":0,"authenticated":False})
receipt={"started_at":now(),"url":url,"attempt":1,"retry":0,"TLS_verify":True,"allow_redirects":False,"authenticated":False}
try:
    session=requests.Session()
    session.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)","Accept":"text/html,application/xhtml+xml"})
    response=session.get(url,timeout=(12,30),allow_redirects=False,verify=True)
    session.close()
    raw=response.content
    rawpath=out/"2018Q3_唯一原发布页首次响应_E115.html"
    if rawpath.exists():raise RuntimeError("原发布页首次响应已存在")
    rawpath.write_bytes(raw)
    receipt.update({"completed_at":now(),"http_status":response.status_code,"response_url":response.url,"content_type":response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
       "redirect_location":response.headers.get("Location"),"http_date_not_publication_clock":response.headers.get("Date"),
       "last_modified_not_publication_clock":response.headers.get("Last-Modified"),"bytes":len(raw),"path":rel(rawpath),"sha256":sha(raw),
       "status":"FIRST_RESPONSE_SAVED_BINDING_PENDING","encoding_hint":response.encoding,"apparent_encoding_hint":response.apparent_encoding})
except Exception as exc:
    receipt.update({"completed_at":now(),"status":"ONE_GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY","error_type":type(exc).__name__,"error":str(exc),"http_status":None})
save("唯一发布页首次GET回执_E115.json",receipt)
assert sha(pdf.read_bytes())==proposal["fixed_original_identity"]["saved_pdf_sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"登记完成":True,"首次GET":1,"HTTP状态":receipt["http_status"],"响应字节":receipt.get("bytes"),"未重取原PDF":True,
      "原发布事件绑定":"待同原响应解析","金融候选":0,"拟合":0,"现有源码修改":0,"goal":"active"},ensure_ascii=False))
